newsitem.title: JAPAN: TENNIS-SELES, DATE ADVANCE TO QUARTER-FINALS IN TOKYO.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SELES, DATE ADVANCE TO QUARTER-FINALS IN TOKYO.

text.p: Monica Seles cruised to the quarter-finals of the $450,000 Nichirei international women's tennis tournament on Wednesday when she beat Japan's Mana Endo 6-4 6-4.
The top seed led the first set 4-0 before losing three games in a row. "Mana was hitting a lot of great balls," Seles said after her second round match.
"She can hit hard shots but can also hit them soft so it was hard to read what was coming over the net," she added.
In the quarter-finals, Seles takes on seventh seed Naoko Sawamatsu of Japan, who easily downed her compatriot Yuka Yoshida 6-2 6-1.
Local favourite Kimiko Date, ranked eighth in the world and seeded third here, needed three sets to oust her compatriot Nana Miyagi 4-6 6-4 6-3.
Fifth seed Amanda Coetzer of South Africa also advanced to the quarter-finals after defeating Japan's Naoko Kijimuta 7-6 (8-6) 6-2.
